text:
Maya: FYI saw a small but consistent invoice drift for tenant acme-inc this morning (~2.3%). anyone else seeing a route attribution bump? :thinking:
Rahul: Noticed a rise in 'default-route' charge events in the hourly rollup. Could be missing x-route-id.
Maya: Pulled raw billing events and found ~6k events with explicit null route_id landing into default SKU between 16:05-16:20 UTC.
Jon: That coincides with the edge-proxy canary. I pushed a tiny change in PR #1209 to `strip_empty_headers` to normalize headers.
DeployBot: deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-21T16:05 -> edge-proxy v2.3.4 (canary 10/100) finished.
Maya: Example (sanitized) event I grabbed:
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_abc123",
  "tenant_id": "acme-inc",
  "session_id": "sess_123",
  "tokens": 314,
  "headers": {"user-agent":"sdk/1.2.0"},
  "route_id": null
}
```
Rahul: If header canonicalization turned an absent header into an explicit null, our metering consumer considers that routeless and falls back to default-route. Previously absence meant 'use session->route map'.
Jon: I can confirm the PR change makes header keys with empty values set to JSON null when forwarding. It passed unit tests but we missed an end-to-end contract.
Ellie: We should add a console alert: % of events with null/empty route_id > 0.5% in a 15m window. Also a per-route attribution trend card. I'll file a Console-UX ticket.
Maya: For mitigation I'm running a repair job to rehydrate route_id using session map and replay to `billing-repair` topic.
Rahul: Suggested quick SQL to find candidates:
```sql
SELECT event_id FROM billing.events
WHERE route_id IS NULL
  AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM sessions.route_map WHERE ts > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 3 HOUR));
```
Jon: Good plan. We'll replay corrected events into billing-repair, then run a dry-run invoice to estimate the charge delta before committing.
DeployBot: deploy-bot: rollback requested -> edge-proxy v2.3.4 -> v2.3.3 initiated at 16:25.
Ops-Bot: ops-bot: incident 2026-03-21-176950 created; notifications suppressed; creating incident channel.
Rahul: Postmortem action items: 1) revert strip_empty_headers default immediately, 2) add integration test asserting no invoice delta >0.1% for header handling changes, 3) add an end-to-end telemetry contract asserting header/route preservation from proxy -> metering consumer -> invoice. I'll draft PRs for 1 and 2.
Jon: I'll also add a small shim in the metering consumer: treat explicit null route_id same as missing and attempt session join before defaulting. That buys us time for the revert.
Maya: I'll post counts from the repair job in ~30m. Keep comms here and in the incident channel. Thanks! :thumbsup:
